compact_notes: heavy evidence stripped per ADR-0010 convention (full detail regenerable via the recorded command in report_meta.args; pairs JSONL in scratch): pairs/exact_hash/normalized_hash lists (counts in result.counts) and per_ku_matches contexts (11320 entries across topics; ku_id lists retained per topic/vault)

limitations: candidate generation only: no overlap_type is assigned or implied
term coverage is exactly the provided terms/aliases map; topics outside it are invisible to this run
word-boundary matching does not stem: 'ridges' does not match 'ridge' unless declared as an alias
mermaid_node_suspect flags matches inside mermaid code blocks (node labels AND edge references) plus the immediate-'[' heuristic outside them; other diagram syntaxes are not detected
hash duplicates compare whole KU excerpts only, not fragments inside units
counts are never semantic evidence; every classification requires excerpt review
result.method: word-boundary case-insensitive term/alias matching over KU excerpts ((?<!\w)term(?!\w) lookarounds); matches inside mermaid code blocks and matches immediately followed by '[' are flagged mermaid_node_suspect and never count as confirmed evidence; code_block-unit matches carry an informational flag
